title: Use AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates and add a Locale('he') variant across dashboard widget tests
why: No shared pumpApp helper exists anywhere in test/helpers/ (TQ-3 is [P]ending, not yet built). Seven files in this batch hand-spell the same 4-item l10n delegate list (11 total call sites) instead of the 1-line AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates shortcut that this same batch's active_track_card_layout_test.dart already uses correctly — adding a 5th delegate later means editing 7 files instead of 1. More concretely: DashboardScreen is the app's home/hotspot screen in a bilingual RTL-first app (AX-1, the dedicated Hebrew-terms system, and this batch's own active_tracks_carousel_rtl_test.dart all attest to how seriously RTL is taken here), yet none of dashboard_screen_test.dart's three pumpWidget sites ever set locale: Locale('he') — a Hebrew-layout regression on the dashboard's own scaffold would ship undetected by its own test file.
recommendation: Switch the 7 files to AppLocalizations.localizationsDelegates; add a Locale('he') pump variant to dashboard_screen_test.dart's core render test, reusing the pattern already proven in active_tracks_carousel_rtl_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: grep -c 'GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate' across the 7 files drops to 0
dashboard_screen_test.dart gains a testWidgets case that pumps with locale: Locale('he') and asserts no exception/overflow

corrections: Total GlobalCupertinoLocalizations.delegate occurrences across the 7 files is 12, not 11 (dashboard_tier_row_test.dart and dashboard_screen_test.dart each have 3, skeleton_pp15 has 2).
